doc: Tensor tables of NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B-A9B for hf_names/nemotron_h_moe.json: 'gguf' = the shipping 24GB GGUF (names, ggml shapes, types), 'hf' = the BF16 release's language-model safetensors keys and shapes except routed experts, 'hf_experts' = per MoE layer the expert count (keys experts.0 .. count-1 all present) and the up / down shapes. Read from the headers by HTTP range requests on 22 Nov 2026 (HRX-like E264).
